title: VACUUM POWER BRAKE
summary: Power brake option (RPO J50): the vacuum brake booster (power brake head) bolted to the firewall over the brake pedal housing with a gasket, the master cylinder on the front of the booster, brake pipes to the pressure differential (distribution) switch, and the vacuum hose from the booster check valve to a fitting in the intake manifold. Booster nuts are inside on the pedal housing; the master cylinder is held by production nuts and washers on the booster studs.

materials.where: master cylinder [9] reservoirs; fill to .25 in. ± .125 from top

fastening.to: brake pedal housing [4] through the dash panel (firewall)
fastening.note: Booster [1] studs pass through gasket [2], the firewall and pedal housing [4]; nuts [6] go on from inside the car. Booster studs are part of the head assembly (no separate stud callout).
Master cylinder [9] with gasket [12] goes on the booster's front studs, held by production nut & washer (no callout, torque 4). Install seal & retainer [13] on the cylinder first.
NOTE: install seal & retainer on cylinder before installing cylinder to head.

fastening.to: master cylinder [9] ports and pressure differential switch
fastening.note: Pipe tube nuts at the master cylinder (triangle 3); at the switch below the cylinder near the steering gear housing, triangles 2 (100-140 lbs in).

fastening.to: booster check valve and engine vacuum fitting
fastening.note: Clamps [10] on each end of vacuum hose [11].

View B: fitting threads into the manifold; torque 5 plus additional torque to align. Fitting [16] at 120° from engine centerline (base V-8), 90° (LT1 & LS5-LS7); [15] at 120°; [14] at 100°. Hose A to vacuum reserve tank, hose B M40 hose.
View A: pipe & support [17] clamped under the production bolt at the accelerator cable bracket (prod bolt, no callout). Triangle 6 is next to callout 17 in the main view.
Cover [3], pedal housing [4] and striker [5] carry 'same as production' symbols; attachment not detailed.

notes: NOTE: Install seal & retainer to cylinder before installing cylinder to head.
NOTE: Brake pedal must support an 80 lb. load at "A" after traveling a maximum of 1.8". Check with motor off and no vacuum assist (View C).
NOTE: Brake system to be inspected for leaks at 1800 PSI for 10 seconds. Pressure differential switch must not activate during this test.
* Plus additional torque to align fitting.
A Hose to vacuum reserve tank. B M40 Hose.
View B: 120° (BASE V-8), 90° (LT1 & LS5-LS7), 120°, 100° from engine centerline.
